answer: Each agent must present a hardware module sealed in its own cedar case, and the light from that module's surface passes through a prism into an optical fingerprint hashed to one enrolment tag, so a thousand keypairs collapse into one device. Only a signed quote from that module, staked behind a forfeitable bond held on a public ledge, buys a ticket to transact, and a ledger replay cancels duplicate tags inside a rolling window. Attacker price: one case, one module, plus forfeited stake per identity, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand devices.
